snippet.title: SUPERPIP: LEVEL ONE
snippet.description:
Link to play: https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/984838
Superpip: Level One is a point-and-click adventure game where you help Pip the Flower track down his lost bike all the way up a strange mountain. But first, there's a big caterpillar blocking the path to the Evil Castle, and you'll need to figure out how to deal with it.

Credits:

• ChutneyGlaze (Author): https://chutneyglaze.newgrounds.com
• Maiden-Chynna (Voice Actor): https://maiden-chynna.newgrounds.com
• StufflingDX (Music): https://stufflingdx.newgrounds.com
